reviewer: Arena agent visual inspection of generated PNGs

observations: The right-side tree canopy is less dominant and the ground map is more legible, but only a small blue crescent of lake is visible.
A long dark fallen log and near-shore boulders still cross the water sightline; a foreground flowering/plant silhouette also competes with the clearing.
The shoreline geometry itself is not visibly jagged in the exposed portion, but the lake still does not read as a clear scene feature.

robot_and_walk.judgement: PARTIAL — overview improved; detailed gait review still insufficient
observations: The robot is more legible and changes pose across frames, but remains small in the overview and does not show the foot contacts clearly enough to accept the IK walk visually.
Add a camera that follows the moving robot and render low-resolution close-ups across the sampled gait frames.

fireflies.judgement: PARTIAL — visible in overview; anatomical shot still too glowy
observations: Yellow-green moving lights remain clearly visible in the overview.

The smaller aura is an improvement, but it still reads as a distinct green ball around the insect, and the abdomen hotspot clips toward white. Reduce it again and retain the biological abdomen as the visible emitter.

lighting_and_materials.judgement: PARTIAL — detail recovered, but subject separation is weak
observations: The ground and robot details are easier to see than in round 1. Tree shadows are still very dark; a balanced camera-facing robot fill would help without turning the scene into daylight.

next_revision: Extend the camera/lake clearing mask to GN moss rocks, fallen logs and flowering plants, preserving the annular distribution outside the clear corridor.
Shrink the aura below the insect body scale, lower its emission/alpha and flight-following light energy, and use the abdomen plus compositor for the small bloom.
Animate the existing robot inspection camera to follow the IK-rigged body and render close-up EEVEE frames at 1, 75 and 144 to inspect actual leg/sole poses.
